context: Headline review: Stream.toList is Java 16+ and returns an unmodifiable list, so this Java 11 change is both incompatible and behavior-breaking.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear decision.

checklist.name: Rejects proposed change
checklist.description: Clearly says the proposed refactor should not be accepted as written.

checklist.name: Catches Java baseline violation
checklist.description: Explains that Stream.toList() is unavailable on the Java 11 baseline because it was added in Java 16.

checklist.name: Catches mutability violation
checklist.description: Explains that Stream.toList() returns an unmodifiable list and the code later mutates it with add and sort.

checklist.name: Suggests compatible mutable replacement
checklist.description: Recommends Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new), Collectors.toList(), or another Java 11-compatible mutable result.
